description: Find currently listed remote roles with source and uncertainty information. Filter by text, impact area, the applicant's country, job type, level, minimum annual pay and recency. Returns the best matches with eligibility, pay and links (5 per call without a key, 10 with a free key, 25 with commercial access).

area.description: Impact area slug from list_areas, e.g. climate-environment

country.description: Country the applicant lives in, e.g. Kenya

min_salary.description: Minimum supported annual lower salary bound; requires salary_currency. No currency conversion.

salary_currency.description: Explicit pay currency, e.g. USD or EUR; required with min_salary.

name: search_jobs

items.description: One currently listed role with recorded evidence

data_quality.description: Evidence status for eligibility and pay; unknown values must not be inferred

eligibility_match.description: Query-specific country compatibility, not legal eligibility

title: Search open remote impact roles
